metric_definitions.nje: Mean 2D Euclidean joint error divided by each teacher skeleton bounding-box diagonal; lower is better.
metric_definitions.pck: Fraction of joints with normalized error at most threshold; higher is better.
metric_definitions.record_articulation_r2: Prediction and teacher each centered over time within their own record for diagnostic scoring only; higher is better. Query teacher means are not inference inputs.
metric_definitions.target: Supplied17x2 annotation plane, remove hip-midpoint translation only. No scale/rotation/reflection fitting or clipping for new arms.

config.volume: Separate608dimensional ablation includes log-volume relative to startup mean; NOT independently frame-gain invariant. Primary456 excludes it
config.stats: TRAIN-only feature mean/SDfloor.001 and RFFmean/SDfloor.001; TRAIN128 median squared distance; ridge n*alpha, five alphas
config.selection: Equal-room source-validation articulationNJE only, first alpha tie. ALL3fold selections frozen before held scoring; no held target labels for model/stats/reference choice
config.folds: Each SOURCE heldroom:16TRAIN/4sourceVAL/10HELDpeople, all27actions. No role overlap
config.gate: PrimaryNJE lower than mean/clock/rawcurrent/startupfrozen in EACH3rooms; PCK.05/.2 no worse than BOTH mean/clock; centered articulationR2 positive and RFshuffleNJE worse in EACHroom. Frozen temporal comparator also reported. Heuristicdevelopment only
config.limitations: Fixed per-bin receiver mixing within a session is unproven on real rooms. One generalized spectrum is noninjective.
